answer: Sealed-bid admission slots: each epoch only 50 new identities are admitted, going to the highest sealed bids, paid in POA and burned. One fake identity costs about 40 POA, ten fake accounts cost roughly 600 as bids climb, and a hundred fake identities cannot fit in 50 slots. Bids sit in a public willow ledger anyone can replay, and a falcon auditor samples 10 percent of winners for shared funding, slashing 70 percent of the bid. Limit: a rich attacker still buys a few slots, and pigment-thin new accounts earn weight slowly.
